body:
## Summary
Implementation-ready **research and engineering plan** for Yamakan vs Higgsfield / Runway / Kling / Luma and open donors. **Research and planning only** — no engine enablement, no weight downloads, no paid API runs, public release **NO-GO**.

Research baseline: main `a3c3ce9`; live head changes with review repairs — see PR header and exact-head CI.

## Package (`docs/research/competitive-video-rea-2026-10-22/`)
| Doc | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `00_INDEX.md` | DoD, evidence grades |
| `01_COMPETITOR_AND_SOURCE_REA.md` | Official API-verified competitor map + open pins |
| `02_BENCHMARK_AND_CONTINUATION_PLAN.md` | Fair A–G protocol; REA-01–06 research closure |
| `03_SOURCE_TRANSPLANT_AND_COPY_VS_BUILD.md` | Exact pins, modules, copy-vs-build, qualification tests |
| `04_TARGET_ARCHITECTURE_AND_ROADMAP.md` | Generation→edit architecture preserving canonical authority |
| `05_PRODUCT_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md` | Feature × TESTED/DOCUMENTED/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN |
| `06_OUTPERFORM_GAPS_AND_PATH.md` | What Yamakan can/cannot match; shortest path |
| `07_ENGINE_DECISION_AND_E0_E2_GATES.md` | Primary worker choice, real hardware/weights feasibility, security tests |

## Verified competitor anchors (DOCUMENTED, not TESTED outputs)
- **Higgsfield Cinema Studio 4.0 API:** `POST /higgsfield/cinema-studio/4.0`; duration **4–30s**; **480p/720p**; refs ≤30/10/10; creative enums (lens/light/pacing/…)
- **Runway catalog:** Gen-4.5, Aleph 2.0, multi-model marketplace (dynamic model count) (incl. Kling/WAN/Veo/audio)
- **Kling capability map (2026-10-20):** 2.5–4.0 / Omni / Elements / Motion Control
- **Luma:** legacy Dream Machine (`ray-2` / `ray-flash-2`); current Agents API (`ray-3.2`) — separate capabilities

## Open source pins (GitHub API 2026-10-22)
- ComfyUI `1a82e6d…` (GPL) → out-of-process **ADAPTER** only
- Wan2.2 `1ea34ff…` (Apache) → first candidate **ti2v-5B**
- Diffusers `48cdbae…` · LTX-2 `e98f6d9…` (DEFER) · VBench `fd18b3d…` (EVAL) · CogVideo `7a1af71…` (alternate)

## Architecture recommendation
Keep Yamakan project/timeline/jobs/security canonical. Diffusers-first sidecar (ComfyUI only as evidence-qualified fallback) behind existing `EngineAdapter` (`ENGINE_ENABLED=false`; `comfyui.ts` does not exist yet). Generate → content-addressed media → typed attach → deterministic edit/export. Providers remain OFF until founder F. Cinema metadata ≠ model conditioning until a measured control compiler exists.

## What Yamakan can outperform today vs cannot match
- **Can (tested/strong):** offline editable ownership, recovery, deny-by-default agent surface, deterministic export, Arabic RTL automation, $0 silent inference cost
- **Cannot yet:** frontier T2V/I2V, hosted Cinema conditioning, character/elements AI, native generative A/V, multi-model marketplace, inference on Intel UHD QA host

## Explicitly NOT RUN
Paid competitor generations · local weight inference · blind human study · official VBench GPU scores · D1 / Alibaba Code Review / PStack / Graft formal reviews

## Non-goals / gates
No production engine code · no `ENGINE_ENABLED=true` · no providers · no unauthorized weights · no large downloads · **public release NO-GO** (decision G open)

## Next (separate engineering PR after founder read)
E0–E2: bounded stdio adapter + isolation + missing-weights tests, engines flag-off. Wan reference ≥24GB VRAM; HF Diffusers model files ~34.2GB; no available zero-cost GPU verified. Founder F required before checkpoint access → Category A edit expansion can proceed without F.
title: research: complete competitive video REA (implementation-ready plan; engines OFF)
